name: pulse-chat
description: Pulse Chat is a Discord-like local chat app with text channels, voice rooms, and server groups.

scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
